header.name: Sam Kirk
header.title: Senior Software Engineer - AI Platform & Cloud Applications

summary: Accomplished Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of Python, 4+ years of TypeScript, and extensive experience building full-stack applications integrated with Google Cloud AI platforms including Vertex AI and Gemini. Combines modern cloud and API integration with a deep background in scalable software frameworks, automated testing pipelines, telemetry data analysis, and engineering mentorship.

experience.title: Chief Consulting Engineer
bullets: Architected and deployed full-stack web applications and AI services using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Google Cloud backends including Vertex AI, Firestore, and Cloud Storage.

Engineered the 'Hire Me' AI Tools Suite utilizing Google Cloud Vertex AI, featuring automated job-fit analysis, generative tailored resume creation, and an interactive Q&A chatbot with citation tracking.
Developed 'Photo Fun,' an AI-driven image transformation tool integrating Google Gemini, TypeScript, React, Vite, and Firebase, deployed on Vercel with production Vertex AI integration.
Built interactive neural-symbolic AI demos (Tensor Logic) using a TypeScript/Vite frontend connected to a high-performance Rust/Axum API service deployed on Shuttle.rs.
Implemented automated web test suites using Vitest and Playwright, establishing robust test coverage and continuous verification workflows.

experience.title: Test Engineer III - Embedded Software
bullets: Engineered Python software verification and regression testing suites for connected medical point-of-care instrument platforms.
Developed automated API reference documentation using a custom Sphinx extension and published it to internal engineering servers.
Designed plans and specifications for cellular radio Quality of Service (QoS) and Over-The-Air (OTA) communication test protocols.
Proposed and developed full remote-access instrument wrappers enabling continuous integration and automated test execution across physical target interfaces.

experience.title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
bullets: Architected an extensible, object-oriented test automation framework in Python to mediate between cloud backend servers and hardware clients for Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware updates.
Implemented concurrent application log streaming and multi-level logging systems to capture diagnostic data during automated execution.
Built modular, dynamically loaded test procedures featuring complete context management of system resources and multi-level stop-on-fail execution controls.
Structured extensive YAML-based configuration systems for test parameterization on Ubuntu Linux, managing code reviews and issues via GitLab and Jira.

experience.title: Sr. Diagnostic Software Engineer
bullets: Created telemetry data visualization and analysis pipelines in Python utilizing numpy, pandas, and matplotlib to process multi-dimensional data streams from system monitors.
Constructed SQL databases for parsed, cleaned telemetry data, creating time-series visualizations and cross-tabulations of system status words.
Developed synchronous environmental data collection and system test logging software in Python to correlate operational metrics with test events in time.
Implemented host production test suites and distributed control software in Python across BeagleBone Black controllers running Debian Linux.

experience.title: Sr. Software Engineer
bullets: Developed high-speed timing calibration software and diagnostic applications for multi-channel digital instruments using C++ and Python.
Automated the generation of complex XML test patterns using custom Python scripts to streamline instrument verification.
Co-designed parallel, generic binary search algorithms applied across multiple calibration and diagnostic tools.

experience.title: Sr. Test Program Engineer
bullets: Engineered functional and performance test platforms for enterprise storage hardware running Linux with SQL database result tracking.
Mentored a new college graduate engineer in software test development methodologies and lab execution best practices.
